name: Disch

🍽️ Welcome to Disch 🍽️

Dig into the sinks around the map in search for crazy items. Talk to the NPC's to discover amazing quests. Dive into the water and pull out insane items and explore a very well size restaurant and maybe even make some friends along the way!
